descriptionChirho: The physical end, tip, or extremity of a concrete object such as a staff, rod, curtain, or pole.
The edge, rim, or border of a physical object or area, such as the edge of a garment, curtain, or camp boundary.
The uttermost part or farthest reach of a land, territory, or the earth, often in the expression 'from one end to the other.'
Locative use indicating position at the end or extremity of a geographical feature such as a mountain, valley, or field.
The end of a span of time, meaning 'after' or 'at the end of' a specified number of days, months, or years.
Used in distributive expressions meaning 'from every end' or 'from every quarter,' indicating all directions or sides.
